{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA rows: revenue = 999999.99
qa_rows = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Check the `converted` status of QA rows
qa_converted_rate = qa_rows['converted'].mean()
print(f"Conversion rate among QA rows: {qa_converted_rate}")

# Drop the QA rows
df_clean = df[~(df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99)].copy()

# Confirm removal
print(f"Number of rows after removing QA: {len(df_clean)}")"}
